channel.title: Apache SkyWalking – Profiling
channel.description: Recent profiling posts from Apache SkyWalking

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 9/17: Five Profilers, One Flame Graph
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 9 of the Meet Horizon UI series: SkyWalking's five profilers — trace, async (JVM), eBPF, Go pprof, and network — four of them pouring into one shared flame-graph and stack-tree engine, and the fifth rendering a process honeycomb instead.

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 9/17：五种 Profiler，一套火焰图
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 系列第九篇：SkyWalking 的五种 profiler：trace、async（JVM）、eBPF、Go pprof 和 network。前四种统一进入同一套火焰图和调用树视图，network 则用蜂窝拓扑展示进程间通信。

item.title: AI Coding 如何重塑软件架构师的工作方式
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: 以 SkyWalking GraalVM Distro 为例，聊聊 AI Coding 如何让更好的架构方案更容易被验证、打磨并真正落地。

item.title: SkyWalking GraalVM Distro：设计与基准测试
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: 从设计到测试，详解 SkyWalking GraalVM Distro 如何把一个成熟、运行时动态特性很多的 Java 可观测性后端做成原生二进制，并沉淀出可重复的迁移流程。

item.title: How AI Changed the Economics of Architecture
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: A case study in how AI changed the economics of architecture in a mature project by making better designs cheaper to prototype, validate, and refine.

item.title: SkyWalking GraalVM Distro: Design and Benchmarks
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: A technical deep-dive into SkyWalking GraalVM Distro — how we turned a mature, reflection-heavy Java observability backend into a native binary with a repeatable migration pipeline.

item.title: Profiling Java application with SkyWalking bundled async-profiler
item.dc:creator: zhengziyi0117
item.description: This document presents an introduction to and usage of the async-profiler in SkyWalking.

item.title: SkyWalking 10 Release: Service Hierarchy, Kubernetes Network Monitoring by eBPF, BanyanDB, and More
item.dc:creator: Kai Wan, Sheng Wu. tetrate.io
item.description: Introduce what's new in SkyWalking 10, including Service Hierarchy, Kubernetes Network Monitoring by eBPF, BanyanDB, and more.

item.title: SkyWalking 10 发布：服务层次结构、基于 eBPF 的 Kubernetes 网络监控、BanyanDB 等
item.description: 介绍 SkyWalking 10 的新特性，包括服务层次结构、基于 eBPF 的 Kubernetes 网络监控、BanyanDB 等。

item.title: Monitoring Kubernetes network traffic by using eBPF
item.dc:creator: Han Liu
item.description: This article demonstrates how SkyWalking uses eBPF technology to monitor network traffic on Kubernetes.

item.title: 将 Apache SkyWalking 与 Arthas 集成
item.dc:creator: 魏翔
item.description: 本篇文章演示如何将 Arthas 集成到 SkyWalking 中，并借此场景讨论 SkyWalking 中的常见扩展点。

item.title: Activating Automatical Performance Analysis -- Continuous Profiling
item.dc:creator: Han Liu
item.description: Introduce and demonstrate how SkyWalking implements eBPF-based process monitoring with few manual engagements. The profiling could be automatically activated driven by the preset conditions.

item.title: 自动化性能分析——持续剖析
item.dc:creator: 刘晗
item.description: 介绍并演示 SkyWalking 如何在很少的人工参与下实现基于 ebpf 的进程监控。在预设条件的驱动下，剖析可以自动激活。

item.title: eBPF enhanced HTTP observability - L7 metrics and tracing
item.dc:creator: Han Liu, Sheng Wu
item.description: This article will show how to use Apache SkyWalking with eBPF to enhance metrics and traces in HTTP observability.

item.title: 使用 eBPF 提升 HTTP 可观测性 - L7 指标和追踪
item.dc:creator: 刘晗，吴晟
item.description: 本文将展示如何使用 Apache SkyWalking 与 eBPF 来增强 HTTP 观察性中的度量和追踪。

item.title: Diagnose Service Mesh Network Performance with eBPF
item.dc:creator: Han Liu, Sheng Wu
item.description: This article will show how to use Apache SkyWalking with eBPF to make network troubleshooting easier in a service mesh environment.

item.title: Pinpoint Service Mesh Critical Performance Impact by using eBPF
item.dc:creator: Han Liu, Sheng Wu
item.description: Introducing performance analysis in production with SkyWalking Rover

item.title: Scaling with Apache SkyWalking
item.dc:creator: Han Liu, Sheng Wu
item.description: Introduce how to load balance the traffic between SkyWalking backend and agent through SkyWalking Satellite

item.title: SkyWalking Python Agent Supports Profiling Now
item.dc:creator: [Ke Zhang](http://github.com/HumbertZhang), Committer; [Sheng Wu](https://github.com/wu-sheng), Tetrate.io, Apache SkyWalking Creator; [Zhenxu Ke](https://github.com/kezhenxu94), Tetrate.io.
item.description: This post introduces how to use profiling in SkyWalking Python Agent and the mechanism of profiling.

item.title: End-User Tracing in a SkyWalking-Observed Browser
item.dc:creator: [Qiuxia Fan](https://github.com/Fine0830). tetrate.io
item.description: This article describes how the skywalking-client-js extends its monitoring to include the browser, providing performance metrics and error collection to the SkyWalking backend.
